name: GA Cubers Return A 2021
information:
This competition is **outdoors**, please dress appropriately for the weather.
Due to COVID, we will be restricting the people in the pavilion to only competitors; all spectators and guests must remain outside the pavilion for the duration of the competition. We recommend bringing a fold up chair to sit in outside of the pavilion, this will also help with social distancing.

Please review the competitor information tab before the competition.
Please review the covid precautions tab for information regarding steps taken to increase the competitor safety at this competition.
Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.
